name: COMMAND MADNESS [THE BANANA UPDATE]
desc:
💥 WELCOME TO COMMAND MADNESS! 💥

👑 PLAYING AS ADMIN: Hunt down the Survivors to earn Abuse Points. Spend your Abuse Points to unlock insane, overpowered Admin Commands and control the game!

🏃 PLAYING AS SURVIVOR: Run, hide, and outsmart the Admin to earn Survivor Points. Unlock powerful items that help you escape, hide, and fight back!

👾 SPECIAL GAME MODES: Partake in Random Special Game Modes to earn massive amounts of Points!

⭐ VIP Server Notice:
You can't earn Points or Wins in VIP Servers the normal way. Instead, all players automatically receive +800 Abuse Points and +400 Survivor Points every 8 minutes!

👍 Like and Favorite for more updates! ⭐
